map.输入招聘漏斗各环节人数（简历 → 面试 → Offer → 入职），自动计算各阶: Enter headcounts at each recruitment funnel stage (resumes → interviews → offers → onboarding) to automatically compute stage conversion rates and the overall conversion rate, locating the stage with the heaviest loss. map.📚 深度解析：招聘渠道、预算与漏斗的联合统计: 📚 Deep dive: joint statistics on recruitment channels, budget and funnel
map.按渠道汇总花费与产出，算单 offer 成本（CPO）与单入职成本。: Aggregate spend and output per channel to get cost per offer (CPO) and cost per hire.
map.预算受限时，把资源从低效渠道调向高转化渠道。: When budget is tight, move resources from inefficient channels to high-conversion ones.
map.季度招聘效能复盘，支撑来年预算编制。: Review quarterly recruiting effectiveness to support next year's budgeting.
map.猎头花 6 万得 6 offer → CPO 1 万；内推花 1 万得 8 of: A headhunter spends 60000 CNY for 6 offers → CPO 10000; referrals spend 10000 for 8 offers → CPO 1250; job boards spend 30000 for 4 offers → CPO 7500, so referrals deliver the best value.
map.削减网站 30% 预算转内推，预计同等花费多 3 个 offer。: Cutting 30% of job board budget and moving it to referrals is expected to yield 3 more offers for the same spend.
map.还要看入职留存与岗位层级，高端岗 CPO 天然高但价值大，单看成本会误砍关键渠道: Also weigh retention and job level: senior roles naturally cost more per offer but deliver more value, so judging cost alone can cut a critical channel.
map.品牌渠道怎么计量？: How do you measure brand channels?
map.被动投递难归因，建议用渠道标记 + 入职后来源问卷补齐，避免只算付费渠道。: Passive applications are hard to attribute; use channel tags plus a post-hire source survey, and do not count only paid channels.
map.招聘（渠道/预算/漏斗）统计。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全: Recruitment (Channel / Budget / Funnel) Statistics. Free online tool, processed entirely in the browser, no data uploaded, your privacy and security protected.
map.按渠道分别录入花费与漏斗人数（简历 → 面试 → Offer → 入职），计算各: Enter cost and funnel counts (resume → interview → offer → hire) per channel to compute each channel's conversion rate, CPO, cost per hire and totals, flagging the channel with the lowest cost per hire. All computation stays in the browser.
map.单渠道：简历→面试率 = 面试 ÷ 简历；面试→Offer 率 = Offer: Per channel: resume→interview rate = interviews ÷ resumes; interview→offer rate = offers ÷ interviews; offer→hire rate = hires ÷ offers; overall conversion = hires ÷ resumes × 100%
map.渠道成本：单 Offer 成本(CPO) = 花费 ÷ Offer；单入职成本: Channel cost: cost per offer (CPO) = spend ÷ offers; cost per hire = spend ÷ hires
map.汇总：整体转化率 = Σ入职 ÷ Σ简历；平均单入职成本 = Σ花费 ÷ Σ入职: Totals: overall conversion = Σhires ÷ Σresumes; blended cost per hire = Σspend ÷ Σhires
map.按渠道填写花费与漏斗人数；整行留空的渠道会自动忽略，各环节人数需逐级递减。: Fill in spend and funnel counts per channel; fully blank rows are ignored, and counts must decrease stage by stage.
map.单入职成本最低渠道按「花费 ÷ 入职」比较，仅统计入职人数大于 0 的渠道；CP: The lowest cost-per-hire channel compares spend ÷ hires, counting only channels with hires above 0; read CPO and cost per hire together with job level and retention.
map.默认三渠道：内推性价比最高: Default three channels: referrals win on cost
map.内推花 1 万、200 简历、8 offer、7 入职 → CPO 1250、单: Referrals: CNY 10k, 200 resumes, 8 offers, 7 hires → CPO 1250, cost per hire 1428.57; job board: CNY 30k, 4 offers, 3 hires → CPO 7500, cost per hire 10,000; headhunter: CNY 60k, 6 offers, 5 hires → CPO 10,000, cost per hire 12,000. Total CNY 100k and 15 hires → blended cost per hire about ¥6,667 (100000/15=6666.67), overall conversion 15/630=2.38%.
map.预算再分配：先算理论增量，再校验供给: Budget reallocation: compute the theoretical gain, then check supply
map.把招聘网站的 3 万预算砍半（省 1.5 万）转投内推，按内推单入职成本 142: Halve the job board's CNY 30k budget (saving 15k) and move it to referrals: at CNY 1428.57 per hire that is about 10 more hires (15000/1428.57≈10.5) — but the referral resume pool caps it, so confirm capacity first or the money cannot be spent.
map.各渠道花费怎么分摊？: How should shared spend be allocated?
map.只把可归属到具体渠道的费用填进该渠道行；无法归因的品牌宣传、招聘系统订阅等共用成: Only put spend attributable to a channel in that row; book unattributable brand advertising or job-system subscriptions separately instead of spreading them across channel CPO, which would overstate every channel's cost.
